reference_sql:
SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_type
alternatives: SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n_orders FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31' GROUP BY s.store_type
SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) = TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT s.store_type, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id WHERE date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) = TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: Truncating each time to its month is short to read, but it runs a function on every row before comparing.
